allowed_followups: Only each named paper and its author-linked public release family; no additional paper family.
ingestion_route: Preserve original web provenance as Execute evidence artifacts. Existing native GitHub-file observation receipts apply only to actual GitHub file sources.
outcome_inspection_condition: Immutable source/selection protocol published before per-episode outcome or repair-response inspection and before computation.
requested_observations: Paper identity, version, exact methods/configurations and source attribution
Reported recovery, detection, resampling and clean-trajectory disruption distinctions
Author-linked release identities, provenance, file hashes, schema and episode manifest availability
Actual access failures and absent or unsupported outcome denominators
selection_rule: First eligible source in the frozen order; at most the first100 stable episode ids in bytewise order from the release manifest; no outcome-based filtering or replacement.
